# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

Regulators are established or appointed by government. They enforce regulations and rules.

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

[![Image 5: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=4LoBPVSR)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=WKrOLDPC)

[![Image 6: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=ZyAGLcps)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=Yb0VO-hy)[![Image 7: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=AiOKUi1B)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=kM9iEGuE)[![Image 8: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=hlayf_Z_)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=rX99PJ4j)[![Image 9: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=P_2DGysj)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=7fdwBQRQ)

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

## The hazards to consumers

Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

# Caravan and motorhome owners urged to check for deadly faulty water heaters before the holidays

### Published

4 Dec 2020

Consumers are urged to check their caravans and recreational vehicles (RVs) for dangerous Suburban-branded water heaters which may emit deadly carbon monoxide.

The Suburban Recreational Vehicle water heater can operate using electricity or gas, and may produce unsafe levels of carbon monoxide when gas is used to generate the heat.

Carbon monoxide poisoning can cause death, and exposure for a short amount of time can lead to serious injuries. Carbon monoxide has no smell and is unlikely to be detected. It is also highly flammable and can explode on contact with a spark or flame.

The Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC), with the ACCC’s assistance, is raising awareness of the need for repair of thousands of water heaters.

“Do not use the affected water heaters in gas mode under any circumstances,” ACCC Deputy Chair Delia Rickard said.

“It’s especially important to check your caravan’s water heater as soon as possible if you plan to go away during the summer holidays. It only takes a minute and it could save the lives of your loved ones.”

“We are concerned that a large number of deadly heaters remain in caravans and RVs because owners have not yet contacted Coast to Coast for an inspection. Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure has recalled these heaters due to the serious hazards they present. Owners should not take this issue lightly and act quickly,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers can check if their heater is affected by opening the exterior access door to the hot water service and checking the model and serial number located on the right hand side. They should then enter the serial number at the Coast to Coast website.

“Anyone with an affected water heater should urgently contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure on 02 9645 7685 who will arrange for a licensed gas fitter to inspect their water heater free of charge,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers will not have to cover any costs related to the supply and installation of the new water heater, or any required associated work, such as the modification of cavity and gas and/or water lines.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will check every unit, after being contacted by consumers, to ensure the water heater is properly installed and if needed, will replace the unit through a licenced gasfitter free of charge.

Consumers who experience difficulties obtaining a timely remedy should contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure, their state or territory gas regulator or the [ACCC online](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/contact-us/for-consumers/report-an-unsafe-product).

## Background

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure notified [a recall for Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca) on 15 November 2019 due to their serious safety hazards. 18,139 heaters have been sold across all states and territories in Australia mostly installed in caravans and RVs via [certain caravan and motorhome retailers](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/Traders%20list_23.xlsx).

Gas regulators have been working with Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure to identify a suitable safe replacement water heater. Replacement models initially proposed by Suburban, the overseas manufacturer, also failed testing. A safe model was finally produced, and approved for use in July 2020.

Remediation could not commence until the GTRC was satisfied of the safety of the replacement units. The supplier then needed to import sufficient units from the US manufacturer, at a time when their supply chains were impacted by the pandemic situation.

The supplier advises stocks of replacement units are now in hand and they are keen to get remediation happening quickly. To date, only 210 units have been remediated or scheduled for inspection, and the supplier would like to encourage greater consumer response to the recall.

The affected products are the Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters with model numbers SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA, SW6DECA and SW6PA that have serial numbers between 181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D') and between 8183311827 and 8190201139. They were manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

The [Office of the Technical Regulator (SA)](https://www.sa.gov.au/topics/energy-and-environment/electrical-gas-and-plumbing-safety-and-technical-regulation/about-the-otr/office-of-the-technical-regulator) is the responsible regulator for this product. It is a member of the Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC). The GTRC is composed of gas technical and safety regulators across Australia and aims to apply a consistent regulatory approach to improve gas safety, measurement and quality.

More information is available at [Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure — Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca).

# Caravan and motorhome owners urged to check for deadly faulty water heaters before the holidays

### Published

4 Dec 2020

Consumers are urged to check their caravans and recreational vehicles (RVs) for dangerous Suburban-branded water heaters which may emit deadly carbon monoxide.

The Suburban Recreational Vehicle water heater can operate using electricity or gas, and may produce unsafe levels of carbon monoxide when gas is used to generate the heat.

Carbon monoxide poisoning can cause death, and exposure for a short amount of time can lead to serious injuries. Carbon monoxide has no smell and is unlikely to be detected. It is also highly flammable and can explode on contact with a spark or flame.

The Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC), with the ACCC’s assistance, is raising awareness of the need for repair of thousands of water heaters.

“Do not use the affected water heaters in gas mode under any circumstances,” ACCC Deputy Chair Delia Rickard said.

“It’s especially important to check your caravan’s water heater as soon as possible if you plan to go away during the summer holidays. It only takes a minute and it could save the lives of your loved ones.”

“We are concerned that a large number of deadly heaters remain in caravans and RVs because owners have not yet contacted Coast to Coast for an inspection. Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure has recalled these heaters due to the serious hazards they present. Owners should not take this issue lightly and act quickly,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers can check if their heater is affected by opening the exterior access door to the hot water service and checking the model and serial number located on the right hand side. They should then enter the serial number at the Coast to Coast website.

“Anyone with an affected water heater should urgently contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure on 02 9645 7685 who will arrange for a licensed gas fitter to inspect their water heater free of charge,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers will not have to cover any costs related to the supply and installation of the new water heater, or any required associated work, such as the modification of cavity and gas and/or water lines.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will check every unit, after being contacted by consumers, to ensure the water heater is properly installed and if needed, will replace the unit through a licenced gasfitter free of charge.

Consumers who experience difficulties obtaining a timely remedy should contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure, their state or territory gas regulator or the [ACCC online](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/contact-us/for-consumers/report-an-unsafe-product).

## Background

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure notified [a recall for Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca) on 15 November 2019 due to their serious safety hazards. 18,139 heaters have been sold across all states and territories in Australia mostly installed in caravans and RVs via [certain caravan and motorhome retailers](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/Traders%20list_23.xlsx).

Gas regulators have been working with Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure to identify a suitable safe replacement water heater. Replacement models initially proposed by Suburban, the overseas manufacturer, also failed testing. A safe model was finally produced, and approved for use in July 2020.

Remediation could not commence until the GTRC was satisfied of the safety of the replacement units. The supplier then needed to import sufficient units from the US manufacturer, at a time when their supply chains were impacted by the pandemic situation.

The supplier advises stocks of replacement units are now in hand and they are keen to get remediation happening quickly. To date, only 210 units have been remediated or scheduled for inspection, and the supplier would like to encourage greater consumer response to the recall.

The affected products are the Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters with model numbers SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA, SW6DECA and SW6PA that have serial numbers between 181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D') and between 8183311827 and 8190201139. They were manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

The [Office of the Technical Regulator (SA)](https://www.sa.gov.au/topics/energy-and-environment/electrical-gas-and-plumbing-safety-and-technical-regulation/about-the-otr/office-of-the-technical-regulator) is the responsible regulator for this product. It is a member of the Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC). The GTRC is composed of gas technical and safety regulators across Australia and aims to apply a consistent regulatory approach to improve gas safety, measurement and quality.

More information is available at [Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure — Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

[![Image 6: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=ZyAGLcps)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=Yb0VO-hy)[![Image 7: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=AiOKUi1B)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=kM9iEGuE)[![Image 8: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=hlayf_Z_)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=rX99PJ4j)[![Image 9: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=P_2DGysj)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=7fdwBQRQ)

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

Regulators are established or appointed by government. They enforce regulations and rules.

**Quote PRA number 2019/17885** when contacting a regulator about this recall.

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

[![Image 5: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=4LoBPVSR)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=WKrOLDPC)

[![Image 6: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=ZyAGLcps)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=Yb0VO-hy)[![Image 7: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=AiOKUi1B)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=kM9iEGuE)[![Image 8: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=hlayf_Z_)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=rX99PJ4j)[![Image 9: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=P_2DGysj)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=7fdwBQRQ)

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

[![Image 5: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=4LoBPVSR)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=WKrOLDPC)

[![Image 6: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=ZyAGLcps)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=Yb0VO-hy)[![Image 7: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=AiOKUi1B)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=kM9iEGuE)[![Image 8: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=hlayf_Z_)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=rX99PJ4j)[![Image 9: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=P_2DGysj)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=7fdwBQRQ)

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

Regulators are established or appointed by government. They enforce regulations and rules.

Models:

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

[![Image 5: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=4LoBPVSR)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=WKrOLDPC)

[![Image 6: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=ZyAGLcps)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_1.jpg?itok=Yb0VO-hy)[![Image 7: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=AiOKUi1B)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Photograph%20of%20Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service.jpg?itok=kM9iEGuE)[![Image 8: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=hlayf_Z_)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_0.jpg?itok=rX99PJ4j)[![Image 9: Photograph of Suburban RV Hot Water Service](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/media_library/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=P_2DGysj)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/styles/wide/private/Suburban%20RV%20Hot%20Water%20Service_3.jpg?itok=7fdwBQRQ)

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA - Updated remedy

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure

### Recall published

15 November 2019

### Topics

[Gas products and appliances](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10043)

[Vehicle accessories (registered)](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10104)

[Caravan, motorhome and camper accessories](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recalls?f%5B0%5D=topic%3A10107)

## Product description

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6PA
*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

Serial numbers between:

*   181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D'), and
*   8183311827 and 8190201139.

**How to identify affected water heaters:**Open the exterior access door to the water heater and check the model and serial number located on the right-hand side.

Manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

Sold between 1 May 2018 and 25 September 2019.

See the list of affected serial numbers in the 'Identifying features' section below.

There are 18,139 affected units.

See a list of details to help identify the product

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters fitted to caravans, motorhomes and horse float campers.

Models:

*   SW6DEA
*   SW6DA
*   SW4DEA
*   SW4DA
*   SW4DECA
*   SW6DECA

## Reason the product is recalled

A component of the water heater may be improperly manufactured and allow carbon monoxide into your caravan, motorhome or horse float camper.

## The hazards to consumers

Carbon monoxide is a poisonous gas and can cause serious illness, injury or death. Carbon monoxide has no smell or taste, is highly flammable and can only be detected with a carbon monoxide alarm. Loss of consciousness can occur within minutes and death can occur within hours. Further information on the hazards of carbon monoxide can be viewed [here](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/news/carbon-monoxide-safety).

## What consumers should do

Consumers who have not already had their unit inspected must not use the affected water heater in gas mode under any circumstances, even if they have a carbon monoxide detector.

**The remedy for this recall was updated on 29 January 2024. An inspection is no longer required, all affected water heaters that have not already been inspected will be replaced for free.**

Contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure for a free replacement.

Call 02 9645 7685 or email recalls@coastrv.com.au.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will offer compensation for any additional consequential loss suffered by the consumer where there is damage or devaluation to the caravan or motorhome attributed to the installation of a replacement water heater. Consequential loss will be determined on a case by case basis.

For more information visit [www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall](https://www.coastrv.com.au/suburban-recall).

# Caravan and motorhome owners urged to check for deadly faulty water heaters before the holidays

### Published

4 Dec 2020

Consumers are urged to check their caravans and recreational vehicles (RVs) for dangerous Suburban-branded water heaters which may emit deadly carbon monoxide.

The Suburban Recreational Vehicle water heater can operate using electricity or gas, and may produce unsafe levels of carbon monoxide when gas is used to generate the heat.

Carbon monoxide poisoning can cause death, and exposure for a short amount of time can lead to serious injuries. Carbon monoxide has no smell and is unlikely to be detected. It is also highly flammable and can explode on contact with a spark or flame.

The Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC), with the ACCC’s assistance, is raising awareness of the need for repair of thousands of water heaters.

“Do not use the affected water heaters in gas mode under any circumstances,” ACCC Deputy Chair Delia Rickard said.

“It’s especially important to check your caravan’s water heater as soon as possible if you plan to go away during the summer holidays. It only takes a minute and it could save the lives of your loved ones.”

“We are concerned that a large number of deadly heaters remain in caravans and RVs because owners have not yet contacted Coast to Coast for an inspection. Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure has recalled these heaters due to the serious hazards they present. Owners should not take this issue lightly and act quickly,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers can check if their heater is affected by opening the exterior access door to the hot water service and checking the model and serial number located on the right hand side. They should then enter the serial number at the Coast to Coast website.

“Anyone with an affected water heater should urgently contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure on 02 9645 7685 who will arrange for a licensed gas fitter to inspect their water heater free of charge,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers will not have to cover any costs related to the supply and installation of the new water heater, or any required associated work, such as the modification of cavity and gas and/or water lines.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will check every unit, after being contacted by consumers, to ensure the water heater is properly installed and if needed, will replace the unit through a licenced gasfitter free of charge.

Consumers who experience difficulties obtaining a timely remedy should contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure, their state or territory gas regulator or the [ACCC online](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/contact-us/for-consumers/report-an-unsafe-product).

## Background

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure notified [a recall for Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca) on 15 November 2019 due to their serious safety hazards. 18,139 heaters have been sold across all states and territories in Australia mostly installed in caravans and RVs via [certain caravan and motorhome retailers](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/Traders%20list_23.xlsx).

Gas regulators have been working with Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure to identify a suitable safe replacement water heater. Replacement models initially proposed by Suburban, the overseas manufacturer, also failed testing. A safe model was finally produced, and approved for use in July 2020.

Remediation could not commence until the GTRC was satisfied of the safety of the replacement units. The supplier then needed to import sufficient units from the US manufacturer, at a time when their supply chains were impacted by the pandemic situation.

The supplier advises stocks of replacement units are now in hand and they are keen to get remediation happening quickly. To date, only 210 units have been remediated or scheduled for inspection, and the supplier would like to encourage greater consumer response to the recall.

The affected products are the Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters with model numbers SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA, SW6DECA and SW6PA that have serial numbers between 181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D') and between 8183311827 and 8190201139. They were manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

The [Office of the Technical Regulator (SA)](https://www.sa.gov.au/topics/energy-and-environment/electrical-gas-and-plumbing-safety-and-technical-regulation/about-the-otr/office-of-the-technical-regulator) is the responsible regulator for this product. It is a member of the Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC). The GTRC is composed of gas technical and safety regulators across Australia and aims to apply a consistent regulatory approach to improve gas safety, measurement and quality.

More information is available at [Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure — Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca).

# Caravan and motorhome owners urged to check for deadly faulty water heaters before the holidays

### Published

4 Dec 2020

Consumers are urged to check their caravans and recreational vehicles (RVs) for dangerous Suburban-branded water heaters which may emit deadly carbon monoxide.

The Suburban Recreational Vehicle water heater can operate using electricity or gas, and may produce unsafe levels of carbon monoxide when gas is used to generate the heat.

Carbon monoxide poisoning can cause death, and exposure for a short amount of time can lead to serious injuries. Carbon monoxide has no smell and is unlikely to be detected. It is also highly flammable and can explode on contact with a spark or flame.

The Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC), with the ACCC’s assistance, is raising awareness of the need for repair of thousands of water heaters.

“Do not use the affected water heaters in gas mode under any circumstances,” ACCC Deputy Chair Delia Rickard said.

“It’s especially important to check your caravan’s water heater as soon as possible if you plan to go away during the summer holidays. It only takes a minute and it could save the lives of your loved ones.”

“We are concerned that a large number of deadly heaters remain in caravans and RVs because owners have not yet contacted Coast to Coast for an inspection. Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure has recalled these heaters due to the serious hazards they present. Owners should not take this issue lightly and act quickly,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers can check if their heater is affected by opening the exterior access door to the hot water service and checking the model and serial number located on the right hand side. They should then enter the serial number at the Coast to Coast website.

“Anyone with an affected water heater should urgently contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure on 02 9645 7685 who will arrange for a licensed gas fitter to inspect their water heater free of charge,” Ms Rickard said.

Consumers will not have to cover any costs related to the supply and installation of the new water heater, or any required associated work, such as the modification of cavity and gas and/or water lines.

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure will check every unit, after being contacted by consumers, to ensure the water heater is properly installed and if needed, will replace the unit through a licenced gasfitter free of charge.

Consumers who experience difficulties obtaining a timely remedy should contact Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure, their state or territory gas regulator or the [ACCC online](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/contact-us/for-consumers/report-an-unsafe-product).

## Background

Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure notified [a recall for Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca) on 15 November 2019 due to their serious safety hazards. 18,139 heaters have been sold across all states and territories in Australia mostly installed in caravans and RVs via [certain caravan and motorhome retailers](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/system/files/Traders%20list_23.xlsx).

Gas regulators have been working with Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure to identify a suitable safe replacement water heater. Replacement models initially proposed by Suburban, the overseas manufacturer, also failed testing. A safe model was finally produced, and approved for use in July 2020.

Remediation could not commence until the GTRC was satisfied of the safety of the replacement units. The supplier then needed to import sufficient units from the US manufacturer, at a time when their supply chains were impacted by the pandemic situation.

The supplier advises stocks of replacement units are now in hand and they are keen to get remediation happening quickly. To date, only 210 units have been remediated or scheduled for inspection, and the supplier would like to encourage greater consumer response to the recall.

The affected products are the Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters with model numbers SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA, SW6DECA and SW6PA that have serial numbers between 181315552 and 193002648 (some serial numbers may end with a 'D') and between 8183311827 and 8190201139. They were manufactured between 4 April 2018 and 1 August 2019.

The [Office of the Technical Regulator (SA)](https://www.sa.gov.au/topics/energy-and-environment/electrical-gas-and-plumbing-safety-and-technical-regulation/about-the-otr/office-of-the-technical-regulator) is the responsible regulator for this product. It is a member of the Gas Technical Regulators Committee (GTRC). The GTRC is composed of gas technical and safety regulators across Australia and aims to apply a consistent regulatory approach to improve gas safety, measurement and quality.

More information is available at [Coast to Coast Caravan and Leisure — Suburban Recreational Vehicle Water Heaters Model SW6PA, SW6DEA, SW6DA, SW4DEA, SW4DA, SW4DECA and SW6DECA](https://www.productsafety.gov.au/recall/coast-rv-pty-ltd-suburban-recreational-vehicle-water-heaters-model-sw6pa-sw6dea-sw6da-sw4dea-sw4da-sw4deca-and-sw6deca).

# 500 Series Cooker Grill and Cooktops for Caravans and Motorhomes

Official notice

23 Jun 2022

Last checked

23 Jun 2022

High risk[ACCC](https://recallscope.com/source/accc)

An official ACCC notice concerns 500 Series Cooker Grill and Cooktops for Caravans and Motorhomes. If the gas leaks in the presence of an ignition source this can lead to an explosion and/or fire, which may result in serious illness, injury or death. The defect has caused incidents that have caused serious injuries and burns. Published 2022-06-23.

## What to do now

For cookers manufactured between 1 January 2019 and 31 May 2020 (inclusive) : 1. Turn the front left burner control knob to the off position, remove the knob and store it out of reach of other users. 2. DO NOT USE the front hotplate left burner. The other burners and the electric hotplate can be used. 3. Contact a Swift service agent to arrange an inspection and repairs (if required). Swift service agents information is available here: https://swiftappliancegroup.com.au/repairs-warranty/ If you are in a remote area or unable to access an approved Swift service agent, contact a licensed plumber or gasfitter and request they contact Swift for authorisation and instructions on how to conduct the remedial process. Contact details for Swift Appliance Group: • swiftrecall@outlook.com • 0412 821 912 (Monday to Thursday 8am to 4:30pm and Friday 8am to 1:30pm) • Register your details and receive updates: https://swiftappliancegroup.com.au/recall-register It is recommended that consumers install a gas leak detector inside the cupboard underneath the gas cooker unit if the caravan or motorhome is intended to travel off-road.

# 500 Series Cooker Grill and Cooktops for Caravans and Motorhomes

Official notice

23 Jun 2022

Last checked

23 Jun 2022

High risk[ACCC](https://recallscope.com/source/accc)

An official ACCC notice concerns 500 Series Cooker Grill and Cooktops for Caravans and Motorhomes. If the gas leaks in the presence of an ignition source this can lead to an explosion and/or fire, which may result in serious illness, injury or death. The defect has caused incidents that have caused serious injuries and burns. Published 2022-06-23.

## What to do now

For cookers manufactured between 1 January 2019 and 31 May 2020 (inclusive) : 1. Turn the front left burner control knob to the off position, remove the knob and store it out of reach of other users. 2. DO NOT USE the front hotplate left burner. The other burners and the electric hotplate can be used. 3. Contact a Swift service agent to arrange an inspection and repairs (if required). Swift service agents information is available here: https://swiftappliancegroup.com.au/repairs-warranty/ If you are in a remote area or unable to access an approved Swift service agent, contact a licensed plumber or gasfitter and request they contact Swift for authorisation and instructions on how to conduct the remedial process. Contact details for Swift Appliance Group: • swiftrecall@outlook.com • 0412 821 912 (Monday to Thursday 8am to 4:30pm and Friday 8am to 1:30pm) • Register your details and receive updates: https://swiftappliancegroup.com.au/recall-register It is recommended that consumers install a gas leak detector inside the cupboard underneath the gas cooker unit if the caravan or motorhome is intended to travel off-road.

“BY HECLA, IT’S GOOD” HECLA ELECTRICS. MELBOURNE

For over 70 years, Hecla was a leading manufacturer of domestic electric appliances in Australia: heaters, kettles, toasters, irons and etc. (photos of some early products in comments below)

The company’s iconic building on the s/e corner of Chapel Street and Alexander Avenue South Yarra stood for many years and was associated with the brand long after the Company departed the premises.

THE STORY...

Clarence William Marriott began manufacturing Australia’s first Electric carbon filament radiators in the late 1890s. By early in the 20th century his business was doing well, but he was struggling to find a suitable name.

In 1913, Iceland’s Mount Hekla volcano made news with an eruption and Marriott, recognising that this event was associated with heat and power, decided to name his company after it. So was born the name Hecla.

By 1924 business was booming with over 80,000 electric heaters manufactured. They were now doing business in New Zealand, South Africa and the South Pacific. In 1926, just five years after building a new factory and showroom in the centre of Melbourne, they moved to the new 150,000 square foot factory on the corner or Alexandra Avenue and Chapel Street, South Yarra.

In 1928, the company adopted the slogan... “By Hecla it’s good”. And it was...! Hecla was known for innovative ideas, quality product and skilled personnel. 

Hecla experienced financial difficulties in the late 60s and in 1969, merged with H. Rowe & Co. Ltd. They ceased manufacture of domestic appliances and moved into smaller premises in Glenhuntly. By the mid 80s Hecla was simply a brand name applied to imported products.
